Container.Name: Noterat-worker
Container.Overview: Speech to text for Noterat's voice memos, on your Nvidia GPU: KB-Whisper, the National Library of Sweden's Whisper trained on Swedish (other languages work too). It also reads Noterat's scans of documents and receipts: it finds and straightens the page in a photo, reads it in Swedish and English with Tesseract (on the CPU), and makes a searchable PDF. And it reads recipes out of web pages that Noterat fetched but couldn't read by itself (recipe-scrapers, on the CPU; it never fetches anything itself). It asks Noterat for work over the network and sends back the text, which shows up on every device; nothing is kept here but the model (about 3 GB, downloaded on the first start). Needs the Nvidia Driver plugin (unless it only reads scans and recipes), and the same Worker token here as on Noterat (WORKER_TOKEN).
Container.Requires: An Nvidia GPU and the Nvidia Driver plugin (Community Applications). Noterat with WORKER_TOKEN set.

Config.Name: Noterat address
Config.Description: Noterat as this container reaches it: the server's IP and Noterat's port, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3300 (not the public HTTPS address, which goes out and back in through your proxy).

Config.Name: Worker token
Config.Description: The same as WORKER_TOKEN on Noterat: a long random string (e.g. from openssl rand -hex 32). Without it on Noterat, the worker gets no jobs (no transcription, no reading scans or recipes).

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: Which GPU to use: all, or one GPU's UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin's page (GPU-…).

Config.Name: Nvidia capabilities
Config.Description: What the container may use of the GPU: computing (and nvidia-smi).

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: The Whisper model, as a Hugging Face id. KBLab/kb-whisper-large is the most accurate and needs about 4 GB of GPU memory; KBLab/kb-whisper-medium, -small, -base and -tiny need less and are faster but make more mistakes.

Config.Name: Models folder
Config.Description: Where the model is downloaded to on the first start (about 3 GB for large). It can be downloaded again, so it needn't be backed up.

Config.Name: Kinds of job
Config.Description: What this worker does, comma-separated: transcribe (speech to text), ocr (reads scans) and recipe (reads recipes out of web pages). Without transcribe it needs no GPU (take --runtime=nvidia out of Extra Parameters if there's none) and doesn't load the Whisper model.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the worker runs as (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for files the worker creates.
